findings.topic: Melatonin, soy, vitamin E and homeopathy evidence boundaries
findings.implementation: Added current-evidence lesson paragraphs and four original applied questions. Distinguishes uncertain long-term melatonin safety, food associations versus supplement efficacy, vitamin E formal UL versus trial harms, and homeopathy efficacy versus compendium claims.
